easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
